Keep the lower75percent of EVERY shaft, its exact lean angle, root position, scale, overall height, thin brown outline, pale peach-golden flat fill and very light narrow tan shade as closely unchanged as possible. Preserve exact20sprite/5x4grid arrangement and ample transparent gaps. This is one chronological animation: row1left-to-right thenrow2 etc; lastcell repeats firstpose for reference. Draw all20tips individually, coherent lengths/thickness/style, no raster rotation.
